programmes.d: In Joseon, a powerful family is plagued by mysterious wedding-night deaths. Left pregnant after her husband dies, young bride Ok-bun must uncover the deadly secret threatening her unborn child.
As a meddling mom begins investigating her son’s $1000 water bill she instinctively detects a crime behind it.

Saved by an organ transplant, a detective hunts a serial killer—only to discover they both received organs from a murderer he once arrested. Bound by a chilling connection, the two men face off in a relentless chase.
Hyun-soo joins a gang’s stock scheme but as trust erodes everyone plots to betray each other for profit.
Hyunjuli who accidentally falls into a fantasy world of the Moonlit Palace fights against the evil Blossom Lady to protect her new friends.
For catching a gangster a cop Jae-in poses as a high school girl to get close to the gangster's daughter.
Sneaking into So-ra's home Jung-tae finds her dead body. But when it vanishes he's accused of her murder.
Jae-su and 11th mother hostile at first forge a bond over time building trust in their self-reliant world.
An adopted pastor reunites with his shaman brother and together they search for their mother with dementia.
Jae-pil and Sang-gu move into their dream European-style home, only to be mistaken for criminals. Soon, strange visitors arrive and a dark spirit awakens in the basement.
Dong-gun gets plastic surgery to hide his ugly looks after blind Hae-ju regains sight from an eye transplant.
Joseon's best bounty hunter Jin-ok takes on a high-reward case unaware it points to her father's killer.
Soon-yi joins band heading to Vietnam to find her husband in the Vietnam War singing for soldiers there.
